title: Queensland recreational boat registration and licences
description: Registering a recreational boat in Queensland and the licences to drive it. Summarised from Queensland Government pages; commercial vessels are certified through AMSA instead.

items.title: Register the boat before using it on Queensland waters
items.detail: Boats (including personal watercraft) with an engine of 3 kW or more must be registered.

items.title: Display the registration number
items.detail: Readable from 30 metres: at least 150 mm on both sides for planing boats, 75 mm for non-planing boats and 100 mm for personal watercraft.

items.title: Get Maritime Safety Queensland endorsement for a boat of 15 metres or more
Hold a recreational marine driver licence to drive a boat with an engine over 4.5 kW
items.detail: Not needed if a licensed person on board supervises and can take control. Minimum age 16.

items.title: Hold a personal watercraft licence as well if it is a jet ski
Record the registration and its expiry in your vessel's certificates
